title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Training Note — Usage Multiplier on a Credit Line Increase
content:
**What does the usage multiplier reward?** A Ridgeline Pro Credit account whose statements show it has outgrown its credit line. The line increase worked on the current credit line is multiplied by the usage multiplier.

**How is it set?** By the highest statement balance on record for the account, and by whether the business's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership carries a dedicated pro account representative:

| Highest statement balance on record | Dedicated pro account representative | Usage multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| Above the current credit line | Yes | 1.15 (representative usage multiplier) |
| Above the current credit line | No | 1.05 (standard usage multiplier) |
| No statement balance on record above the current line | Any | 1 |

**Which statements count?** Every statement on record for the account; the highest statement balance among them is compared with the current credit line. A balance equal to the line is not above it.

**Which memberships carry a dedicated representative?** The business's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership in active status: the ProBuild Gold, ProBuild Platinum and ProBuild Platinum Elite tiers carry one; the ProBuild Member, Bronze and Silver tiers, and a business with no active membership, do not.

**How does it combine?** It multiplies the product of the current credit line and its percentage; where that product is multiplied by more than one figure, the multiplications act on that one product, in any order. The multiplier is not rounded.

**Worked case (hypothetical).** Current line 18000.00, increase worked at 25 percent (4500.00), highest statement balance 18950.00, ProBuild Gold membership: 4500.00 times 1.15 is 5175.00. With a ProBuild Silver membership instead: 4725.00. With a highest statement balance of 18000.00: 4500.00.
